name: arena
install: set -e; if ! command -v cargo >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y --profile minimal --default-toolchain stable -c rustfmt -c clippy; fi; . "$HOME/.cargo/env"; rustup component add rustfmt clippy >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; cargo fetch >/dev/null 2>&1; cargo build --all-targets >/tmp/warm-debug.log 2>&1 || tail -n 40 /tmp/warm-debug.log; cargo build --release --all-targets >/tmp/warm-release.log 2>&1 || tail -n 40 /tmp/warm-release.log; (cd tools && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund >/dev/null 2>&1); if [ ! -d "$HOME/practice-tool" ]; then git clone --quiet https://github.com/melnce/Practice-Tool "$HOME/practice-tool"; fi; (cd "$HOME/practice-tool" && git fetch --quiet origin && git checkout --quiet origin/main && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund >/dev/null 2>&1) || true
